diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving fallopian tube
legend: Lymphoma invades and replaces most of the tube; ovaries and other pelvic structures were also involved.

diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving fallopian tube
legend: Immunostaining for CD20 is diffusely positive. This lymphoma had a non–germinal-centre B-cell immunophenotype. FISH showed rearrangement of BCL6, but not of MYC or BCL2.
